units.distance: grid cells; physical region 10000 m square

observation.access: centralized shared current telemetry and union of active CNN local views; no unobserved-cell ground truth
observation.cnn_local: 15x15x3 uncertainty/occupancy and wind; inactive rows zero
observation.existence_mask: 6 real UAV slots; 4 infrastructure nodes in SAGIN graph
observation.telemetry: current six-slot lifecycle, position, energy, FIFO membership and wait age; no physical telemetry costs simulated
observation.physical_edges: unchanged; no new charging-vehicle or telemetry edges
observation.future: predictions derived only from current state and approximate known energy/charge model

control.P0: frozen CNN argmax with shared observation object; CNN reads only its existing local input
control.P1: shared current-view target matching and deterministic grid path
control.P2: same candidates, energy feasibility, assignment and movement as P1 plus approximate short-horizon availability cost
control.offload_primary: each post-flight eligible UAV requests HAPS; original feasibility and local fallback
control.safety: unchanged target-aware fleet manager overrides any unsafe proposal

reward: unchanged V1.5 flight and offload rewards; search uncertainty updates before offload; return energy not directly included as return reward penalty

metrics.primary: mean coverage across physical steps, coverage=1-mean(uncertainty)
metrics.thresholds: first physical step reaching 0.9 or 0.95; event=false and censoring at episode end when unreached
metrics.energy: cumulative actual search flight + return flight + offload UAV energy
metrics.rotation_window: steps within 10 of active_to_returning or standby_to_active
metrics.repeat: search visits minus newly covered cells divided by search visits
metrics.relaunch_delay: steps from post-charge standby_to_active until that UAV first covers a previously uncertain cell; right-censored on return or episode end
